newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's octuplet mother bears six healthy babies.
newsitem.headline: Spain's octuplet mother bears six healthy babies.

text.p: A Spanish woman who decided to try to carry octuplets to term gave birth to six healthy babies on Thursday after losing two, hospital officials said.
The 31-year-old married woman, Rosario Maria Clavijo, lost the first of her eight babies three weeks ago due to malnutrition.
When another died late on Wednesday, doctors decided to deliver the remaining babies by caesarian section in the 30th week of the pregnancy.
Doctors at the hospital in Huelva, on the south coast, said the surviving four boys and two girls, who weighed between 700 and 1,400 grams (25-50 ounces), were in good health.
Two months ago a British woman tried to give birth to octuplets against her doctors' advice and lost all eight.
Mandy Allwood, also 31, became pregnant after taking powerful fertility drugs and ignoring medical advice to avoid sex for a while.

Rosario, who also took fertility drugs, will receive an emergency aid package from the Spanish government to help look after the six babies. Her husband, with whom she already has a three-year-old daughter, is a bricklayer.
